{{Top|leg}}
'''Vulpines''' were a subgroup of animals. Vulpine [[Species/Legends|species]] included the [[Amaran/Legends|Amarans]].<ref name="WOSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, the term 'Vulpine' is used to describe any fox or near relative of the fox, another [[Canine/Legends|Canine]] animal related to [[Wolf/Legends|Wolves]] and [[Dog/Legends|Dogs]].
